description: A TACC-owned inference server for running AI models.

appArgs.name: flexServPort
appArgs.description: The port on which the FlexServ server will listen. If not specified, it will default to 8000. If any conflict occurs with the port you specified, our bootloader will automatically select another available port and you can check job logs to see which port is actually used.

appArgs.name: flexServSecret
appArgs.description: This is the secret string used for authentication when you access the FlexServ server. You can change it to whatever you want, but make sure to use the same string when you access the server. If you don't set it, it will be a TAP Token generated by TAP functions and you can check job logs to see what it is.

appArgs.name: modelName
appArgs.description: The name of the default model to be used by the FlexServ server.

appArgs.name: loginPort
appArgs.description: The port to use for login, if specified, we will forcibly use this port for the login node and set up port forwarding from the compute node to this port. If not specified, we will have TAP functions select a port and you have to check job logs to see which port is used for login.

appArgs.name: enableHttps
appArgs.description: Enable HTTPS for the FlexServ server.

appArgs.name: modelTimeout
appArgs.description: Model timeout seconds passed to backend (default: 86400).

appArgs.name: isDistributed
appArgs.description: Keep at 0 for single-node mode (default). Distributed mode is currently unsupported.

appArgs.name: servingProfile
appArgs.description: Optional serving profile: auto, baseline, decode, prefill, memory or balanced. Auto uses balanced workload presets with model/hardware capability resolution. Python defaults to balanced when no argument or environment selection is supplied.

appArgs.name: dtype
appArgs.description: Optional profile override: inherit, auto, float16, bfloat16 or float32.

appArgs.name: attnImplementation
appArgs.description: Optional qualified attention override: inherit, auto, eager, sdpa, flash_attention_2, flash_attention_3 or flash_attention_4. Auto uses SM-aware FA2/FA3 preferences and kernel probes. FA4 is explicit and has no Transformers paged-KV fast decode; Qwen3.5 hybrid batching requires SDPA.

appArgs.name: useKernels
appArgs.description: Optional model/hardware kernel policy: auto, true, false or inherit. Auto probes compatible dense Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 recurrent and convolution kernels while retaining concurrent hybrid paging. True requires successful Qwen kernel qualification; false disables optional replacements. Other models retain native execution in auto mode.

appArgs.name: quantization
appArgs.description: Explicit weight quantization selection: none, bnb-4bit, bnb-8bit or checkpoint. No profile implicitly enables quantization.

appArgs.name: continuousBatching
appArgs.description: Continuous batching policy: auto allows ordinary sequential fallback for unsupported models; true requires model support and fails otherwise. Unquantized dense Qwen3.5 is detected automatically for experimental text-only hybrid paging on a single CUDA target; cbHybridCache=off disables this adapter.

appArgs.name: cbHybridCache
appArgs.description: Hybrid paged cache policy: auto (default), off or qwen3.5. Auto detects supported unquantized dense Qwen3.5 with CB enabled on a single CUDA target. The text-only adapter requires SDPA; compile=true attempts tensor-region compilation, auto permits eager CB fallback. Graphs, prefix sharing, CPU offload and async batching remain disabled. GPU qualification pending.

appArgs.name: compile
appArgs.description: Compilation policy: true, false, auto or inherit. On Qwen hybrid continuous batching, true attempts compilation and reports actual failures; auto attempts compilation with eager CB fallback; false disables it. Decode/prefill profile preferences permit fallback. Other models keep separate ordinary compile and cbCompileLevel controls. Balanced defaults to compilation off.

schedulerOptions.name: TACC Scheduler Profile
schedulerOptions.description: Scheduler profile for HPC clusters at TACC

schedulerOptions.name: Slurm job name
schedulerOptions.description: Set the slurm job name to be identical to the Tapis job name.

schedulerOptions.name: TACC Resource Allocation
schedulerOptions.description: Set the TACC resource allocation for the job.

schedulerOptions.name: Reservation Name
schedulerOptions.description: Set the reservation name for the job.

envVariables.description: Token for accessing Hugging Face models, especially for the models that requires permission to download/use from HuggingFace. This is identical to HF_TOKEN
Optional fixed startup token. If empty, TAP token is used.
Venv path in container for backend/gateway startup.

Directory path for Private models. This applies to the $PRI_MODEL_REPO variable used in the app, it will be replaced with this path when the job is running. You can upload your private models to this directory and specify the model name (which is the subdirectory name under this directory) as the input to the app to use those models.

Directory path for Public models. This applies to the $PUB_MODEL_REPO variable used in the app, it will be replaced with this path when the job is running. We will have some commonly used models stored in this directory for users to use, and you can also upload your models to this directory if you want to share them with other users. Similar to PRI_MODEL_HOST, you can specify the model name (which is the subdirectory name under this directory) as the input to the app to use those models.
